maintenance_posture: No current deferred item is actionable after the dated 11-item closeout disposition. Public surfaces remain running, the model and flywheel stack remains cost-stopped, and source freshness reopens on 2026-10-28 or earlier when a volatile fact changes.

policy.completion_rule: An item leaves this outstanding register only after a dated resolution records whether it was executed, declined, excluded from claims, retained by the current owner, or closed with explicit residual risk.
policy.claim_rule: Zero outstanding items must not be described as proof that declined, excluded, private, human-review, provider, notebook, training, or publication work was performed.
policy.cost_rule: No past resolution or future register item authorizes removal of stop sentinels, re-enabling scheduled tasks, provider calls, Kaggle quota use, or registry publication.
policy.privacy_rule: Private receipts retain account, billing, recovery, and reviewer identity details outside Git; public evidence records only dates, categories, decisions, hashes, and pass or fail state.
